bookedClasses.description: Decisions 322, 332. What to do with this slot's upcoming Classes that already have bookings, when the change moves them (day, start or end time, branch), switches the slot off, or changes their booking rules (waiver, membership inclusion, cut-offs, cancellation charge). MOVE: they follow the change and booked Students are told (not with status OFF). CANCEL: their bookings are cancelled with credit back and the Classes archived; Students are told. KEEP: they keep their day, time, place and rules. CANCEL is only for a move or switching off. Required when such Classes exist; without it the update is refused with 409. Also confirms a capacity cut below the seats booked: Classes fuller than the new capacity keep their size. Title, description, picture, coach and styles always reach every upcoming Class. Unbooked upcoming Classes always follow the change.

checkInClosesMinutesAfterStart.description: Decision 394: check-in closes this many minutes after a Class starts (0 = at the start). Null: when the Class ends.

checkInSeveralClasses.description: Decision 394: several Classes may be checked in at once.

checkInCodeDigits.description: How many digits staff codes have here.

visitorsOn.description: Decision 392: the School has a visitor period, so the sign-up form offers Visitor.

heardFromOptions.description: The School's "How did you hear about us?" choices. Null: show the starting list in the tablet's language.

branchId.description: null: a whole-School Class.

seatsTaken.description: Booked or checked in, each with their guests.

profilePhotoUrl.description: A child's photo only while their Guardian's camera consent is active (Decisions 57, 69).

more.description: More matched than were returned: type more of the name.

name.description: Once they signed their waiver: first name and initial.

progress.description: Classes toward the next belt, when a rank counts classes.

bookings.description: The student's bookings in today's Classes here.

fullName.description: First name and surname, as typed.

staffCode.description: A staff member's own code (4 or 6 digits).

unlockedBy.description: First name of the staff member whose code it was.

code.description: The personal check-in code, typed at the front desk in place of the app QR.

hasAccount.description: The email already has a ULTM8 account: approving sends it an invite to accept in the app.

userId.description: The account it became, or the one invited.

deletesAt.description: A rejected sign-up is deleted on this day (Decision 362).

branchId.description: The home branch, when the sign-up came from a School-wide tablet at a School with branches.

accountCreated.description: A new account was made and its temporary passcode emailed.

invited.description: The email had an account: it was sent an invite to accept.

visitPassGiven.description: A Visitor got a visit pass. False when the School has no visitor period set.

emailFailed.description: The email could not be sent.

temporaryPasscode.description: Only when the passcode email failed: hand it over in person.

needsBranch.description: The School has open branches and the invite names none: choose one when accepting.

branchId.description: Your home branch, when the School has branches and the invite names none.

accessToken.description: A fresh access token carrying the new STUDENT grant.

studentId.description: Whose pack: the caller, or a child the caller is Guardian of.

childFirstName.description: The child's first name when it isn't the caller's own pack.

branchId.description: One of the School's open Branches; null when it has none.

disciplineId.description: The style. Required when the School has styles.

startsAt.description: From 30 minutes ago to 24 hours ahead.

notified.description: How many students were told in the app.

branchIds.description: The Branches the caller can start one at; null for any.
